description: Oppo's Enco X4 true wireless earbuds are now available to pre-order in India ahead of their October 29 sale. Priced at Rs. 19,999, they come in Aurora Violet and Glacier White, with a lower listing price of Rs. 18,999 on Oppo's website. The earbuds support multiple audio codecs, spatial audio and adjustable active noise cancellation. They also feature four microphones, Bluetooth 6.1 and dual-device connectivity. Oppo claims up to 53 hours of playback with the charging case when ANC is disabled.
title: Oppo Enco X4 TWS Earbuds Launched in India With Hi-Res Audio, Up to 53 Hours of Total Battery Life

description: CD Projekt Red is rolling out the new Edgerunners 2 update for Cyberpunk 2077. The update is now available on PC, Mac, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X. It adds new quests, cosmetics, mod support, and content inspired by Edgerunners 2 anime to the game. Cyberpunk 2077's free update will be released on Switch 2 in the coming days.
title: Cyberpunk 2077 Gets New Quests, Gameplay Features and Mod Support With Edgerunners 2 Update

description: The ruling came in a case stemming from allegations that Cambridge Analytica, a British political consulting firm involved in Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign, obtained data from millions of Facebook users without their consent. New Mexico had sued Meta, accusing it of lying to Facebook users in New Mexico about who had access to their data.
title: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion Penalty in Data Privacy Case
This Festive Season, Here’s Why It Is the Best Time to Buy a Samsung Galaxy A Series Phone

description: A Chinese court has accepted a case to recover assets linked to an alleged CNY 40.3 billion fundraising fraud operated by Qian Zhimin between 2014 and 2017. The assets targeted include more than 61,800 Bitcoin, 72,700 Bitcoin Cash and 3.6 million XRP, alongside other cryptocurrencies, cash and property. Investors and other interested parties have six months to participate in the confiscation proceedings.
title: China Demands Return of 61,800 BTC Seized in UK Fraud Investigation
5 Reasons the Samsung Galaxy A Series Should Be Your Festive Upgrade This Diwali

description: Google Cloud has added OpenAI models to its Model Garden platform in private preview. The lineup includes GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna. Enterprise developers and businesses can now tap into OpenAI's newest frontier models and other first-party, third-party, and open models on a unified enterprise AI platform.
title: Google Cloud Adds GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna Models to Model Garden

description: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max and Oppo Find X10 have been launched in India as part of the flagship Find X10 lineup. The smartphone sports a 6.78-inch Full-HD+ (1,272 x 2,772 pixels) AMOLED display that refreshes at up to 144Hz. The standard model sports a 6.59-inch Full-HD+ (1,272 x 2,768 pixels) AMOLED display. The other display features remain identical to the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max. An octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, which is built on a 2nm process, powers the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max. The SoC delivers a peak clock speed of up to 4.55GHz. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max packs an 8,000mAh battery and supports 80W (wired) and 50W (wireless) fast charging.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max Launched in India With Triple 200-Megapixel Cameras, Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC, Oppo Find X10 Tags Along: Price

description: Oppo Pad Mini was launched in India on Thursday as the company's first compact flagship tablet. It sports an 8.8-inch 2.5K OLED screen with a 144Hz refresh rate. The tablet runs on the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and runs on Android 16-based ColorOS 16. The screen has a matte finish, which is claimed to reduce glare. The Oppo Pad Mini has a single 13-megapixel rear camera and packs an 8,000mAh battery.
title: Oppo Pad Mini Launched in India With 2.5K OLED Screen, 8,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Lenovo Yoga Pro 9n and Yoga 9n 2-in-1 laptops launched in India with Nvidia RTX Spark superchip. New AI PCs feature OLED displays. The new Lenovo laptops also feature Lenovo Powerhub and Lenovo AI Engine+. Lenovo Yoga 9n 2-in-1 features a convertible design. The Lenovo Yoga Pro 9n features a 15.3-inch 2.5K display, while the Yoga 9n 2-in-1 has a larger 16-inch 2.8K panel.
title: Lenovo Yoga Pro 9n, Yoga 9n 2-in-1 With Nvidia RTX Spark Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: The HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition is a feature phone designed for older adults, with a built-in AI companion called Mary that can chat with users, answer questions and play games. Developed by senior services company inTouch, Mary can also remember previous conversations to make interactions feel more personal. The phone is priced at GBP 79.99 (roughly Rs. 10,100) in the UK and comes with a five-hour free trial of the service. It features dual displays, a physical keypad, 4G connectivity and a removable battery.
title: HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition Launched With AI Companion Mary, Removable Battery, 4G Support: Price, Features

description: CoinDCX has denied claims of a fresh security breach after researchers flagged cryptocurrency transfers worth approximately $16 million involving wallets associated with the Indian exchange. The company attributed the activity to addresses compromised in its July 2025 breach and said customer funds remained safe. However, ZachXBT disputed the explanation, pointing to transactions allegedly involving CoinDCX-linked wallets months after the earlier incident.
title: CoinDCX Dismisses Second Breach Claims as Blockchain Investigators Examine Wallet Transfers

description: Xiaomi has announced the launch date of its upcoming Redmi Book 2027 series. The lineup will launch on October  27 alongside the Redmi K100 smartphone. ship with a third-generation Intel Core Ultra processor manufactured using Intel's 18A process. The laptops will support LPDDR5X memory. Redmi Book 14 2027 is teased to have a dual-fan 3D airflow system and a 10mm large-diameter heat pipe. This model is confirmed to feature a 72Wh battery.
title: Redmi Book 2027 Series Launch Date Set for October 27; Design, Specifications Teased

description: MEXC has announced plans to discontinue services for certain customers in Russia and Belarus as part of its global compliance policies. The exchange said affected users will receive notifications with instructions for withdrawing funds and exiting their accounts. No public deadline or total number of affected customers has been disclosed, and users who have not received a termination notice can continue trading under the existing terms of service.
title: MEXC to Shut Services in Russia and Belarus as Compliance Rules Tighten

description: Acer has introduced the TravelLite TL44-53M-G2 laptop in India for commercial and enterprise customers. It features a 14-inch Full HD IPS display with a 16:10 aspect ratio and runs on Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors. The laptop supports up to 128GB of dual-channel DDR5 RAM and offers two M.2 PCIe NVMe SSD slots. Other features include Intel vPro technology, a 5-megapixel IR webcam with Windows Hello, Wi-Fi 7, Thunderbolt connectivity and a MIL-STD 810H-certified chassis.
title: Acer TravelLite TL44-53M-G2 Launched in India With 14-Inch Display, Intel Core Ultra Series 3 Chip

description: Bitcoin’s recovery faces a key test as it approaches $85,000, with institutional investment and corporate holdings providing support. However, renewed Middle East tensions, rising bond yields, and $23.4 billion in Bitcoin derivatives open interest could amplify volatility if market sentiment weakens.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $83,000 as Tesla Keeps 11,509 BTC Holdings

description: The Oura Ring 5 was launched in India on Thursday as the latest model in the company's smart ring lineup. The successor to the Oura Ring 4 comes with a smaller design than its predecessor. As per the company, it comes with upgraded sensors, new health-tracking capabilities, and AI-powered wellness features. The Oura Ring 5 has two new activity features, which are claimed to help members understand how exercise impacts long-term cardiovascular health.
title: Oura Ring 5 Launched in India With AI Health Features, Blood Pressure Tracking: Price, Specifications

description: Thailand’s NBTC database lists the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max as model 2611FPNFAG and the Oppo Reno 17 5G as CPH2975. Both phones support 5G, 4G LTE, 3G and 2G connectivity, and the listings hint at an imminent global launch. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max and Xiaomi 18 Pro debuted in China with 8,500mAh and 7,000mAh batteries, respectively. Meanwhile, the Oppo Reno 17 series is expected to launch in China in November, with an India debut possible in early January 2027.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, Oppo Reno 17 5G Receive NBTC Certification Ahead of Global Launch

description: Xbox is rolling out Cloud playtime packs for Xbox Insiders, allowing them to access cloud streaming without a Game Pass subscription. Cloud playtime packs offer 10, 25, and 50 hours of cloud streaming at introductory launch prices of $3.99, $7.99, and $11.99, respectively. The packs will be available to Xbox users widely starting in November.
title: Microsoft Rolls Out Standalone Cloud Playtime Packs to Xbox Insiders

description: Samsung W27 will be launched in China on October 29 during the company's 'Heart of the World' event, according to a report. The phone is said to be based on the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, featuring similar specifications and features. However, the Samsung W27 is expected to boast a more premium finish than the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra. The report further highlights that the Samsung W27 will go on sale in the country on November 5. However, it is already available for pre-order in China, the report reveals. In China, the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra is offered at a starting price of CNY 14,999 (roughly Rs. 2,13,000). On the other hand, the Samsung W27 foldable is expected to be priced higher than its Galaxy Z Fold 8 series counterpart.
title: Samsung ‘Heart of the World’ Event to Take Place Next Week in China to Reportedly Launch Samsung W27 Foldable

description: The Vivo X500 Ultra has been in the rumour mill recently. The company recently confirmed that its launch is slated for early next year. With its unveiling several months away, the purported handset’s specifications remain under wraps. A new leak, however, has shed light on its camera specifications. As per a tipster, Vivo is testing a new telephoto camera sensor for its upcoming flagship. This upgrade is said to enable the Vivo X500 Ultra to capture more light, potentially improving image quality.
title: Vivo X500 Ultra Could Pack a Larger 200-Megapixel Telephoto Sensor, Tipster Claims

description: iQOO 16R has appeared on Indonesia's TKDN certification website with model number I2606. The certification suggests that the Vivo sub-brand might unveil the handset in select global markets soon.  The smartphone was previously spotted on other certification platforms like the GSMA IMEI database. It is expected to come with a Snapdragon chipset. The iQOO 16R is speculated to arrive as a rebranded version of the iQOO Z12 Turbo.
title: iQOO 16R Spotted on TKDN Certification Website, Launch Could Be Imminent

description: The Oppo Reno 16 is said to have received a price hike in India. The handset, which debuted in the country in June this year, is now listed at higher prices on the Oppo India website. The price hike reportedly affects both its RAM and onboard storage configurations. Separately, the brand has also introduced a new variant of the Oppo Reno 16 with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of onboard storage.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Price in India Hiked by Up to Rs. 7,000, New 128GB Variant Introduced

description: A video shared on Weibo shows the inner display of Apple’s iPhone Duo dipping slightly when pressed near the hinge. The post suggests that the softer section could provide cushioning and help the screen handle temperature-related stress, although this explanation has not been confirmed. It also raises concerns about possible marks developing on the surface polymer layer over time. The iPhone Duo features a 7.6-inch inner display, an A20 Pro chipset and dual 48-megapixel rear cameras. It goes on sale in India on October 23.
title: Apple's iPhone Duo Hands-On Video Shows Soft Spot Around Display Crease

description: Vivo has officially set a launch date for its Y600 smartphone in China. The phone is advertised with a 10,000mAh battery, which has reportedly also broken records ahead of its launch. A social media post showed the phone in two colourways and revealed its dual-camera configuration.
title: Vivo Y600 Launch Date Confirmed for October 30 in China, 10,000mAh Battery Revealed

description: Anthropic has launched its latest personal AI-powered work assistant, based on its Opus 5.5 AI model. The AI assistant supports more than 6,000 connectors. Anthropic says that Claude Duet will send a brief every morning about the most important updates, missed notifications, and messages across the connected apps. During the day, the new personal AI assistant will track the connectors for the users and send alerts regarding missed messages. For reference, when a user is required to take action based on a message sent on Slack or Gmail, Claude Duet will inform the user about it. It is currently available in the US for Max and Pro subscribers. Users can join the waitlist to get access to the new Claude Duet AI assistant.
title: Claude Duet AI Assistant Research Preview Powered by Opus 5.5 Model Released as a Standalone iOS, Android App

description: OnePlus is said to be working on the Turbo Pro, which is tipped to launch in China by the end of this year. The handset could feature a 6.78-inch 1.5K display with a 185Hz refresh rate.  It is expected to pack a 200-megapixel primary camera and a battery of up to 10,000mAh. It is likely to run on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Pro chipset.
title: OnePlus Turbo Pro Tipped to Launch With 185Hz Refresh Rate Display, 200-Megapixel Rear Camera

description: Gemini’s Personal Intelligence feature is rolling out to Android Auto. The feature connects Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Photos, Google Maps, YouTube, and Search. Users can get personalised answers to queries. The apps aren’t connected until the user chooses to turn it on, and they can turn it off anytime in their Gemini settings.
title: Google Adds Personal Intelligence to Gemini on Android Auto

description: iPhone Duo will receive Apple Pencil support with the iOS 27.2 update, according to a report. In a post on X, Creative Strategies analyst Max Weinbach has shared an image claiming that the iOS 27.2 release candidate update rolled out on Monday brings Apple Pencil support to the foldable. The image shows the analyst holding an Apple Pencil along with an iPhone Duo with text scribbled on it. Separately, in his iPhone Duo review, Wired’s Julian Chokkattu writes that Apple plans to bring the reachability functionality to the foldable later this year.
title: iPhone Duo to Get Apple Pencil Support With iOS 27.2 Update, Reachability Feature Later This Year: Report

description: Vivo Buds Ultra feature a hybrid driver system, an independent Hi-Fi DAC and LDAC audio transmission at up to 990kbps. Their noise cancellation system offers up to 60dB of noise reduction, while a bone conduction sensor and three microphones support calls. The earbuds include spatial audio, a 10-band equaliser and multipoint connectivity for three devices. They are rated IP54 for dust and sweat resistance and support wireless charging. Vivo has not confirmed Indian pricing or availability.
title: Vivo Buds Ultra Announced With Up to 60dB ANC, Up to 50 Hours of Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: After several leaks and rumours, OnePlus has officially announced the launch date for its Ace 7 series of smartphones. The performance-oriented smartphones will launch towards the end of this month and feature a unique dual-airflow design.
title: OnePlus Ace 7, Ace 7 Pro Launch Date Confirmed for October 27 With New Dual-Airflow Design

description: EA has reportedly laid off 400 workers as part of widespread cuts at the company. The company is also shutting down BioWare, the developer behind iconic franchises like Dragon Age and Mass Effect. The next Mass Effect game, which was in early development at the studio, has been cancelled, as well.
title: EA Shuts Down BioWare, Cancels Next Mass Effect and Lays Off 400 Workers Weeks After Going Private

description: Oppo has raised the price of its recently launched Oppo K14 Plus. The price of the handset now starts at Rs. 32,999 for the base model offering 6GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. Meanwhile, the 8GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration now costs Rs. 36,999. Lastly, the top-of-the-line 8GB + 256GB model is now priced at Rs. 40,999. This marks a notable price hike over the launch price of the smartphone. For reference, the Oppo K14 Plus was launched in India on September 29 at a starting price of Rs. 29,999 for the base option. Meanwhile, the higher-end options were unveiled at Rs. 32,999 and Rs. 35,999, respectively. The company has increased the prices of the variants by Rs. 3,000, Rs. 4,000, and Rs. 5,000, respectively.
title: Oppo K14 Plus Price Hiked by Up to Rs. 5,000 in India Within Weeks of Launch

description: Apple is said to be preparing to roll out the iOS 27.2 update for iPhone next week. While the Cupertino-based tech giant has yet to reveal any details, a new report suggests that it could bring several new features across apps. The update will reportedly improve everyday tasks, from managing conversations and tracking unfinished podcast episodes to making FaceTime calls and controlling compatible smart locks. A new profile section in the Apple TV app for iPhone could also be added.
title: iOS 27.2 Update to Reportedly Bring New iPhone Features Across Messages, Apple TV and More Apps
This Diwali, Upgrade to an NVIDIA RTX 50 Series Laptop and Get 6X More Frames From DLSS 4.5

description: Apple introduced a refreshed brand identity for Apple Music on Wednesday. The Cupertino-based tech giant has given its music streaming platform a new visual language built around sound waves, physical vibrations, and glass-like effects. The redesign follows the appearance of a new logo and app icon earlier this month. Apple has also created a new audio mnemonic to accompany the updated branding, which is claimed to extend across Apple Music’s marketing, original content, events, and product experiences.
title: Apple Music Gets a New Black-and-White Brand Identity Inspired by Sound, Liquid Glass
